name: FAQ Split
description: A two-column FAQ: a left intro (tag rule, oversized heading, sub, tick ruler, note, contact + call button) beside a right single-open accordion with plus-to-x icons.
interactions: single-open accordion driven by JS max-height (measured per item, re-measured on resize); the plus icon rotates to an x; only one item open at a time; prefers-reduced-motion turns transitions off
